messages:
Lina: Quick sync — planning to onboard Catalyst-3.5B into the model-catalog. Target deploy 2026-05-04 15:00 UTC (quiet window). Who can own the deploy + smoke? Need to pin catalyst-3.5b -> v1.2, run the usual latency/cost smoke, and have rollback ready. Also note PR #482 touches registry schema (small change). @Sasha @Marco

Marco: I can own the deploy. 15:00 UTC works for me. I’ll handle the rollout and the alias swap. Will follow the standard runbook. sending runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/catalog-pin

Sasha: I’ll run smoke and quick evals. Plan: smoke tests (end-to-end generate + 50 sample prompts), cost check, and a golden-output diff for regressions. If smoke fails, immediate rollback. :+1:

Avery: FYI infra migration from PR #482 is scheduled 14:30 UTC — it’s a painless registry column add but will restart a couple of microservices. I’ll coordinate to keep the window clear. Please don’t start the pin until migration completes and I ack.

Marco: Noted. I’ll set deploy for 15:15 then to give buffer. Can someone confirm who will run traffic-shift and monitor the per-route latencies?

Joyce: I can watch metrics and paging if anything spikes. I’ll set thresholds: latency increase >15% or token-cost >20% = automatic rollback trigger (manual confirm for partial degradation).

Lina: Rollback plan: revert alias to catalyst-3.5b@v1.1, clear cache, and notify customers via status page if we must extend outage. Marco, can you ensure the rollback playbook is staged as a job?

Marco: Will stage a rollback job and a one-click alias revert. Example pin command I’ll use in ops:

```
# pin model to a catalog version
curl -sS -X POST "https://catalog.redwood/api/pins"\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"\
  -d '{"model":"catalyst-3.5b","version":"v1.2","reason":"onboard 2026-05-04"}'
```

Marco: After pinning I’ll trigger a canary route (5% traffic) for 10m then ramp to 50% if green, then full.

Sasha: For the golden-output diff I’ll use the eval harness in /evals/catalyst/compare_v1.1_v1.2. I’ll post a quick summary 20m after canary. If any major regression (>5% metric drop) I’ll call the rollback.

Avery: Migration done. All services back up. No blocking schema issues. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Deployment queued by Marco for 2026-05-04 15:15 UTC — preflight checks passed (infra ok).

Lina: OK team — final checklist:
- Marco: deploy + alias swap
- Sasha: smoke + golden diffs
- Avery: infra migration ack (done)
- Joyce: monitor + rollback trigger
- Lina: notify product + support once fully live

If nobody objects I’ll mark this as green and let Marco proceed at 15:15. :rocket:

Sasha: No objections from me.

Joyce: All good. I’ll be on-call at 15:15.

Marco: Starting the deploy flow at 15:15. I’ll post updates here (canary start / canary pass / full).

Lina: Thanks — please keep updates short. Good luck.
